patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — ThorData and Zyte share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose ThorData only if your buying job matches “Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper API credit” rather than Zyte's shape. Choose Zyte only if your buying job matches “Zyte API web-data collection (formerly Scrapinghub) — PAYG; monthly commitments from $100;” rather than ThorData's shape. Workflow advantage differs because ThorData is shaped for Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); We whereas Zyte is shaped for Zyte API web-data collection (formerly Scrapinghub) — PAYG; monthly co. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — ThorData and Zyte share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: ThorData is Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper API credit packs from ~$30.; Zyte is Zyte API web-data collection (formerly Scrapinghub) — PAYG; monthly commitments from $100; $5 free trial credit. Does not outrank Bright Dat.
- Company-size focus: ThorData (solo, micro, small-business) vs Zyte (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: ThorData — Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs; Zyte — Formerly Scrapinghub — same vendor; do not treat as two products.

Limitations — ThorData: Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs; Marketing claims should be validated — score from published packaging, not Fortune-500 slogans; Zyte: Formerly Scrapinghub — same vendor; do not treat as two products; Does not outrank Bright Data (7.7).

Poor-fit cases: ThorData is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs · Zyte is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Formerly Scrapinghub — same vendor; do not treat as two products · Avoid ThorData if you actually need Zyte's motion (Zyte API web-data collection (formerly Scrapinghub) — PAYG; monthly commitments )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
